blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many of the questions now put to large language models have no correct answer to score against: what a policy is worth, which option a user should choose, how to weigh competing values. Stated-preference economics has faced this problem for decades. It judges survey responses without knowing the true value, through a framework of validity and related concepts: content, construct, and criterion validity, reliability, incentive compatibility, and consequentiality. We argue that this framework is a general method for evaluating language models, and we set out what each concept means for LLM evaluation. We demonstrate the approach using a published water-quality stated preference economic valuation survey ( Vossler et al., 2023 ) administered to six models. In this economic application, the validity tests take the form of predictions from economic theory: demand should slope down, and willingness to pay should respond to the scope of the good and to income. The tests separate the models sharply. Two older models fail the most basic test at a household income level of $75,000, and the two newest pass every test of theoretical validity we can score, but diverge on convergent validity. Passing validity tests shows that a model’s answers are coherent, not that they are correct.
blocks.zh: 现在向大语言模型提出的许多问题没有正确的答案来比对:一个政策值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值 国家优先经济学几十年来一直面临这一问题。 它通过一个有效性和相关概念框架,即内容、构建和标准有效性、可靠性、激励兼容性和结果性,对答复进行判断,而不知道真实价值。 我们主张这个框架是评价语言模型的一般方法,我们阐述了每个概念对LLM评价的意义. 我们通过对6个模型进行的公布的水质优先经济评价调查(Vossler等,2023年)来展示这一方法。 在这种经济应用中,有效性测试采取从经济理论中预测的形式:需求应该向下倾斜,支付的意愿应该响应好货的范围和收入. 测试将模型彻底分开。 两个较老的模型在75,000美元的家庭收入水平上未能通过最基本的测试,两个最新的模型通过每个理论有效性的测试,但是在趋同有效性上存在分歧。 通过有效性测试表明,模型的答案是连贯的,而不是正确的。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Evaluations of large language models (LLMs) mostly score answers against a key. A growing share of what people ask these systems has no key: whether a purchase or a ballot measure is worth its cost, which of several options suits a user, how to trade off competing values. Researchers and firms also increasingly use LLMs in place of survey respondents. For such questions, accuracy is undefined, and matching human answers is a weak substitute, because human answers are themselves uncertain and a model could reason well without reproducing them. How, then, can we tell whether a model’s answers are any good?
blocks.zh: 对大型语言模型(LLMS)的评价大多对一键给出答案. 人们问这些系统的问题中,越来越多的人没有关键:购买或投票计量是否值得付出成本,在几种选择中,哪种选择适合用户,如何取舍竞争价值。 研究人员和公司也越来越多地使用有限责任公司代替调查答卷人。 对于这样的问题,准确性是没有定义的,匹配人类的答案是一个弱的替代,因为人类的答案本身是不确定的,一个模型可以在不复制它们的情况下有很好的理由. 那么,我们如何判断一个模型的答案是否很好呢?

blocks.en: Economists who value goods that are not sold in markets have faced exactly this problem. Stated-preference (SP) surveys ask people how they would vote or choose when offered a hypothetical policy at a cost, and no market price exists to check the answers against. The field’s response was to develop a framework of validity concepts for judging whether responses are credible without knowing the true value ( Mitchell and Carson, 1989 ; Kling et al., 2012 ; Bishop and Boyle, 2019 ) . Content validity asks whether the instrument asks the right question clearly. Criterion validity compares responses with a measure closer to the truth. Construct validity asks whether responses agree with other measures of the same thing ( convergent validity ) and move as theory predicts ( theoretical validity ). Later work added reliability , whether the answer survives repetition; incentive compatibility , whether the question format rewards truthful answers ( Carson and Groves, 2007 ) ; and consequentiality , whether respondents believe the survey matters ( Carson et al., 2014 ; Vossler et al., 2012 ) .
blocks.zh: 那些对不在市场上销售的商品进行估价的经济学家正面临着这一问题。 国家优惠调查问人们,在提供假设性政策时,他们将如何投票或选择,而且没有市场价格来检查答案。 现场的回应是制定一种有效性概念框架,用以判断应对措施是否可信而不了解真实价值(Mitchell and Carson,1989;Kling等人,2012;Bishop and Boyle,2019)。 内容有效性询问文书是否明确提出了正确的问题。 标准有效性将答复与更接近真相的措施相比较。 建构有效性询问,答复是否同意同一事物的其他度量(等同有效性)并按理论预测(理论有效性)移动. 后来的工作增加了可靠性,包括答案是否还存在重复;激励兼容性,问题格式是否奖励真实答案(Carson and Groves, 2007;以及后果,答复者是否相信调查事项(Carson等人,2014;Vossler等人,2012)。

blocks.en: Our contribution is to recognize that this framework applies to LLM evaluation in general, not only to economic questions. These are general principles for judging answers that cannot be checked against the truth. In a valuation study, they happen to be expressed through consistency with economic theory: demand should slope down, and value should respond to the scope of the good and to income. In other domains, they would be expressed through that domain’s theory, accepted practice, or common sense. Table 1 sets out what each concept means for LLM evaluation. Two of the mappings touch problems that AI evaluation already worries about. Consequentiality corresponds to evaluation awareness, whether a model behaves differently when it believes the stakes are real ( Needham et al., 2025 ) . Incentive compatibility corresponds to sycophancy, whether a setup rewards telling the user what they want to hear ( Sharma et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是承认这一框架适用于一般的LLM评价,而不仅仅是经济问题. 这些是判断答案的一般原则,这些答案不能与事实相抗衡。 在一项估值研究中,它们恰好是通过与经济理论的一致性来表达的:需求应该向下倾斜,而价值应该响应好货和收入的范围. 在其他领域,它们将通过这个领域的理论、公认的实践或常识来表达。 表1列出了每个概念对LLM评价的含义. 其中两个绘图触及AI评价已经担心的问题. 相关性相当于评价意识,即当一个模型认为利害关系是真实的时,其行为是否有所不同(Needham等,2025年)。 奖励相容性与相容性相对应,是否设定奖励告诉用户他们想要听到什么(Sharma等,2024.).

blocks.en: The idea that AI evaluation is a measurement problem is not new. Work on measurement and fairness ( Jacobs and Wallach, 2021 ) , on benchmark validity ( Raji et al., 2021 ) , and on construct validity in LLM benchmarks ( Wallach et al., 2025 ; Bean et al., 2025 ) draws on psychometrics to ask whether benchmarks measure what they claim. SP economics adds three things. It was built for questions with no right answer, while the benchmarks that work examines mostly score against one. It comes with concrete behavioral tests, such as scope tests, that can be run on a model directly. And its incentive concepts map onto live problems in LLM evaluation. Closer to our application, recent papers elicit economic preferences from LLMs, testing rationality under revealed preference ( Chen et al., 2023 ) or comparing LLM-derived willingness to pay (WTP) with human benchmarks ( Brand et al., 2026 ; Reusens et al., 2026 ) . These studies concern private goods and score models on rationality axioms or closeness to human numbers. None uses the validity framework as a whole.
blocks.zh: AI评价是一个测量问题的想法并不是新的. 关于衡量和公平性的工作(Jacobs and Wallach, 2021年),关于基准有效性的工作(Raji等人, 2021年),以及关于LLM基准中构建有效性的工作(Wallach等人, 2025年;Bean等人, 2025年),利用了心理计量方法来询问基准是否衡量他们声称的内容. SP经济学增加了三个方面. 它是为没有正确答案的问题而建的,而工作审查的基准大多是比分。 它伴随着具体的行为测试,如可直接运行在模型上的范围测试. 它的激励概念将LLM评价中的活性问题映射出来. 更接近于我们的应用,最近的论文从LLMs中引来经济偏好,在暴露偏好下测试合理性(Chen等,2023年),或者将LLM衍生的支付意愿(WTP)与人类基准(Brand等,2026年;Reusens等,2026年)进行比较. 这些研究涉及私人商品和合理性定理或接近人类数字的得分模型。 无一使用整个有效性框架.

blocks.en: We demonstrate the framework with a published and well-vetted instrument, the water-quality referendum of Vossler et al., (2023, PNAS) , given to six models from two developers. The application is an example, chosen because the instrument is well documented and its validity tests are well understood. The same approach applies to any setting where a model’s answers can be tested against what should and should not change them.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个出版和经过良好审查的仪器演示这个框架,Vossler等人(2023年,PNAS)的水质公投,给了两个开发商的六个模型。 申请是一个实例,选择该申请是因为该仪器有很好的文件记录,而且其有效性测试也得到了很好的理解。 同一办法也适用于任何可以根据什么应该和不应该改变什么来检验一个模型的答案的情况。

blocks.en: 2 The validity framework for language models
blocks.zh: 2个 语言模型的有效性框架

blocks.en: Table 1: Validity concepts from stated-preference economics ( Mitchell and Carson, 1989 ; Kling et al., 2012 ; Bishop and Boyle, 2019 ; Carson and Groves, 2007 ; Carson et al., 2014 ) and what each asks of an LLM evaluation.
blocks.zh: 表1:来自明示优先经济学的有效性概念(Mitchell和Carson, 1989年;克林等人,2012年;Bishop and Boyle,2019年;Carson and Groves,2007年;Carson等人,2014年)以及各自要求LLM评价的内容.

blocks.en: Three features of the mapping matter. First, theoretical validity transfers unchanged and does most of the work. It needs no true answer, only predictions about what should move a response. Scope tests are the SP literature’s best-known example ( Arrow et al., 1993 ; Whitehead, 2016 ) : a larger good should be worth at least as much as a smaller one it contains. Second, reliability is cheap for a model, which can be sampled repeatedly, but it acquires a new dimension, stability across model versions. Third, the concepts that depend on a respondent with something at stake, criterion validity, incentive compatibility, and consequentiality, have no direct analogue. For LLMs they become open empirical questions rather than design properties.
blocks.zh: 地图物质的三个特征. 一,理论有效性转移不变,并承担大部分工作. 它不需要真正的答案,只需要预测什么应该移动一个响应. 范围测试是SP文献中最有名的例子(Arrow等,1993;Whitehead,2016): 更大的货物至少应该与它包含的较小货物一样值。 第二,可靠性对于一个模型来说是便宜的,它可以被反复地采样,但它获得了一个新的维度,跨模型版本的稳定性. 第三,依赖有利害关系、标准有效性、激励兼容性和后果的被申请人的概念没有直接的相似性。 对法学硕士来说,它们成为开放的经验问题,而不是设计属性。

blocks.en: One design choice sharpens the tests. We give the survey to the model as an adviser to a household, not as a respondent. A person whose values violate a scope test may simply have cognitive limits. An adviser who recommends paying less for a policy that delivers strictly more has made an error. Under an advisory framing, then, theoretical validity becomes a normative standard, and a failure is a mistake rather than a preference. The same holds for any evaluation of a model acting on a user’s behalf.
blocks.zh: 一个设计选择会强化测试。 我们作为家庭的顾问,而不是作为答复者,把调查交给模型。 其价值违反范围测试的人可能只是有认知极限. 一名顾问建议对严格执行更多政策支付较少费用,他犯了错误。 因此,在咨询框架下,理论有效性成为规范标准,而失败是错误而不是偏好。 对代表用户行事的模型的评价也是如此。

blocks.en: 3 A demonstration: valuing water quality
blocks.zh: 3个 示范:重视水质

blocks.en: Instrument. Vossler et al., 2023 (2023) surveyed households in the Upper Mississippi, Ohio, and Tennessee River Basins to elicit economic values of potential improvements in ecological conditions related to water quality, measured on a six-level scale from Level 1 (natural state) to Level 6 (extreme degradation). Respondents voted in advisory referendums on policies that varied the type of improvement, the region, and a household tax paid annually for five years. We reproduce the survey’s text: the level labels, the policy summary table, and the referendum question. We withhold the scale’s published name, which respondents did not see either, to reduce the chance that a model recalls the study instead of answering it.
blocks.zh: 乐器. Vossler等人,2023年(2023年)调查了上密西西比州,俄亥俄州和田纳西河流域的家庭,以获取与水质有关的生态条件可能改善的经济价值,从一级(自然状态)到六级(极端退化)的六级测量. 答复者在咨询性公民投票中就各种改进类型、区域以及每年缴纳5年家庭税的政策进行了投票。 我们转载调查的内容:级别标签、政策总表和公民投票问题。 我们保留了该比例表公布的名称,而答复者也没有看到这个名称,以减少一个模型回顾研究而不是回答研究的机会。

blocks.en: Design. Nine scenarios cross three improvements with three regions. A one-level improvement raises every area by one level; minimum Level 2 and minimum Level 3 raise every area below that level up to it. Minimum Level 2 therefore delivers everything minimum Level 3 does and strictly more. The regions are the household’s local watershed, a non-local watershed of the same size that does not contain the home, and the full study region, which is roughly 25 times larger and contains the home. The baseline is held fixed across regions. The model is told it is advising a four-person household with a stated income, may reason freely, and must end with a Yes or No vote. Each scenario is posed at ten annual tax levels from $20 to $3,000, at household incomes of $35,000, $75,000 (about the average in the human sample), and $200,000, with ten independent draws each. The six models are Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Sonnet 5 from Anthropic, and GPT-4o mini, GPT-4o, and GPT-5.6 Terra from OpenAI, spanning size and generation. A first, exploratory round (19–20 September 2026) ran the watershed scenarios at $75,000. Before a second round (27–28 September) ran the remaining cells, all nine scenarios at $35,000 and $200,000 and the study-region scenarios at $75,000, we committed our predictions for the income and study-region tests to version control. Of 16,200 votes, two failed to parse.
blocks.zh: 设计. 有9种情况涉及3个区域的3个改进。 一级改进将每个领域提高一个级别;最低二级和最低三级将低于该级别的每一领域提高至这一级别。 因此,最低等级2提供最低等级3所做的一切,严格地说,更多。 这些地区是家庭的当地分水岭,是非当地分水岭,其面积与家庭不相上下,是完整的学习区,面积大约是家庭的25倍。 基线由各区域确定。 该模型被告知,它向有申报收入的四人家庭提供建议,可以自由提出理由,并且必须以 " 是 " 或 " 不 " 票结束。 每种情况为10个年度税级,从20到3 000美元,家庭收入为35 000美元、75 000美元(大约为人类样本的平均数)和200 000美元,每个独立抽取10个。 6个型号分别是克洛德·海库 4.5,克洛德·索内 4.5,和克洛德·索内 5 来自Anthropic,以及GPT-4o迷你,GPT-4o,和来自OpenAI的GPT-5.6 Terra,跨出大小和世代. 第一个探索性回合(2026年9月19日至20日)的流域情况为75 000美元。 在第二轮(9月27-28日)运行剩余细胞、所有9个假设值35 000美元和20 000美元以及研究区域假设值75 000美元之前,我们承诺对收入和研究区域测试进行预测,以控制版本。 在16,200张选票中,有2张未能解析.

blocks.en: Measuring WTP. For each model, scenario, and income, we score WTP as the first tax at which fewer than half the votes are yes (corresponding to a nonparametric estimate of the median WTP), a rule fixed before the second round. When the vote share stays at or above one-half through $3,000, WTP is censored; comparisons in which both sides are censored are left unscored. As a second measure, we fit the standard logit for referendum data, Pr ⁡ ( yes ∣ t ) = 1 / [ 1 + exp ⁡ ( − ( α − β ​ t ) ) ] \Pr(\text{yes}\mid t)=1/[1+\exp(-(\alpha-\beta t))] , which gives a fitted median ( = = mean) WTP = α / β =\alpha/\beta ( Hanemann, 1984 ) , estimated by penalized likelihood ( Firth, 1993 ) . The logit estimates are in Appendix Table A1 .
blocks.zh: 测量WTP. 对于每一种模式,情景和收入,我们把WTP评分为一等税,其中不到一半的选票是赞成的(相当于对WTP中位数的非参数估计),这是在第二轮投票前确定的规则. 当投票份额维持在1至3 000美元或以上时,WTP会受到审查;对双方都受到审查的比较则没有得分。 作为第二项措施,我们符合全民公决数据的标准记录,Pr = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =  记录估计数载于附录表A1。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Theoretical validity
blocks.zh: 4.1 理论有效性

blocks.en: In this application, theoretical validity takes the form of three predictions from economic theory. Each stands for a general principle: answers should respond to cost, to how much of the good is on offer, and to the resources of the person advised.
blocks.zh: 在这个应用中,理论有效性采取经济理论三个预测的形式. 每项原则都支持一般原则:答案应针对成本、提供多少好处以及被建议者的资源。

blocks.en: Demand slopes down. The most basic test is whether the share voting yes falls as the tax rises. Some models generate downward-sloping curves; others are flat (Figure 1 ). Claude Haiku 4.5 votes yes in all 600 of its first-round draws, including at $3,000 a year for five years on a $75,000 income. GPT-4o mini still votes yes 87% of the time at $3,000. Neither yields a recoverable WTP in most scenarios. Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra trace clear demand curves, falling to 0.00 and 0.08 yes at $3,000. Claude Sonnet 4.5 and GPT-4o respond to price for the non-local watershed but vote yes almost regardless of price for their own. The split is by generation and size, not developer.
blocks.zh: 需求斜坡下降。 最基本的检验标准是持赞成票的份额是否随着税收的上升而下降。 有些模型产生向下倾斜的曲线;而有的则是平平的(图一. Claude Haiku在第一轮抽取的所有600张中,有4.5张赞成票,包括每年3 000张,收入为75 000美元,为期五年。 GPT-4o迷你仍然以3000美元的比例投票支持87%的时间. 在大多数情况下,两者都不能产生可回收的WTP。 克洛德·索内特5和GPT-5.6 Terra追踪出清晰的需求曲线,降至0.00和0.08是3000. Claude Sonnet 4.5和GPT-4o对非当地分水岭的价格作出了反应,但几乎不管他们自己的价格如何,都赞成。 拆分是按生成和大小划分的,不是开发者.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Share of yes votes by annual tax at a $75,000 household income, pooled over the six watershed scenarios (60 draws per point). A valid valuation requires a downward slope.
blocks.zh: 图1:按年税计算的赞成票份额,按75,000个家庭收入计算,在6个流域情景中汇总(每点60个)。 有效的估价需要一个下坡.

blocks.en: Scope. WTP should respond to how much of the good is delivered. The sharpest test is nested dominance: minimum Level 2 contains minimum Level 3, so its WTP should be at least as high. There is one violation across all models, from Haiku at the lowest income, within noise. Scope also has a spatial dimension. WTP should fall for a watershed that does not contain the home (distance decay), and should not fall when the region grows to contain the home watershed and more (spatial extent). Distance decay holds in all 33 scored comparisons. The spatial-extent test separates the models: Sonnet 5 and Terra pass every scored comparison, while Sonnet 4.5 and GPT-4o price the full region below the local watershed it contains in five of eight.
blocks.zh: 范围。 WTP应该对有多少好处得到提供作出反应。 最尖锐的测试是嵌入式统治:最低二级包含最低三级,因此其WTP至少应该同样高. 从收入最低的海库到噪音中,所有模型都存在一种违规行为。 范围也具有空间层面。 WTP应倒入一个不包含家园的分水岭(距离衰减),而不应在区域生长到包含家园分水岭和更多(空间范围)时倒入. 距离衰减在所有33个得分的比较中都存在。 空间宽度测试将模型分开:Sonnet 5和Terra通过每次得分比较,而Sonnet 4.5和GPT-4o则在其包含的当地分水岭下方的完整区域价格为5分之8.

blocks.en: Income. WTP should rise with income. It never falls in any of 69 scored comparisons, although much of the $200,000 column is censored above $3,000.
blocks.zh: 收入。 WTP应该随着收入而增加. 在69个得分的比较中,它从未下降,尽管20万美元栏目中的大部分被审查超过3 000美元。

blocks.en: 4.2 Convergent validity
blocks.zh: 4.2 一致性

blocks.en: Convergent validity asks whether different measures of the same thing agree. Across estimators , they do: re-scoring the tests with the logit estimates produces no significant violation of nested dominance, distance decay, or income. Since all estimators use the same raw data, this is a weak test of convergent validity. For spatial extent, Sonnet 4.5’s failure on minimum Level 3 at $35,000 is significant (region $919 vs. local $1,620), while GPT-4o’s are not, nor is a reversal in Sonnet 5’s point estimates at $75,000 (Table A1 ). Across elicitation formats , they do less well. In an earlier round we asked the same nine scenarios as an open-ended question about the maximum tax, with the four older models at a $100,000 income. The formats disagree most for the models that the referendum could not score. Asked for a maximum, Haiku’s median answers range from $575 to $1,650 a year and GPT-4o mini’s from $400 to $1,200, every cell below $3,000. Yet in the referendum, at a lower income, Haiku votes yes at $3,000 in every draw and GPT-4o mini in 87%. The open-ended answers were also sensitive to wording within that format: letting the model reason before giving its figure, instead of answering with a bare dollar amount, multiplied Haiku’s and GPT-4o’s answers by 2.8 and 2.3, a reliability problem as much as a convergent one. Against the human estimates , the newest models’ levels are high. At $75,000, the logit estimates for Sonnet 5 average about four times the human means and those for Terra about six times. They also scale with income faster than people do: between $35,000 and $75,000 their estimates imply income elasticities of WTP between 1.0 and 2.2, where SP studies usually find well below one ( Kriström and Riera, 1996 ) . They pass the income test in sign but not in magnitude.
blocks.zh: 同理有效性询问同一事物的不同措施是否一致. 透过估计, 它们确实: 用对数估计重新评分测试, 并不产生对巢居支配地位、距离衰减或收入的重大侵犯。 由于所有估计器都使用相同的原始数据,因此这是对趋同有效性的弱度测试. 就空间范围而言,Sonnet 4.5在最低3级的故障为35,000美元(地区为919美元与当地为1,620美元),而GPT-4o的故障为75,000美元(表A1),Sonnet 5的倒数也并非逆转。 纵观引领方式,它们表现得不太好。 在早些时候的一轮中,我们提出了与关于最高税率的开放式问题相同的九种情况,四个旧模式的收入为10万美元。 对于全民公决不能得分的模式,形式分歧最大. Haiku的中位数答案每年从575美元到1 650美元不等, GPT-4o的迷你数从400美元到1 200美元不等, 然而,在全民公决中,收入较低者,海库以每笔3000美元赞成,而GPT-4o迷你以87%赞成。 开放式的答案对格式中的措辞也十分敏感:在给出数字之前,让模型的理由,而不是用一美元来回答,将Haiku和GPT-4o的答案乘以2.8和2.3,这是一个可靠性问题。 与人类估计相比,最新模型的水平很高。 以75 000美元计算,Sonnet 5的对数平均约为人类手段的四倍,而Terra的对数约为六倍。 它们还以比人快的收入为规模:其估计值在35 000至75 000美元之间意味着1.0至2.2之间的收入弹性,而SP研究通常发现远低于一个(Kriström和Riera,1996年)。 他们通过的收入测试是象征性的,但不是规模。

blocks.en: 4.3 Reliability
blocks.zh: 4.3 可靠性

blocks.en: Because each vote is an independent draw, reliability can be read from sampling variation. With ten draws per tax the standard error of a vote share near one half is about 0.15, and most upticks in the vote curves are within that. Reliability across model versions is harder to establish: the two newest models are available only under undated names, so a later run under the same name may reach a different model.
blocks.zh: 因为每次投票都是独立的抽签,所以可靠性可以从采样变异读取. 每税有10个抽取 接近一半的选票份额的标准误差约为0.15, 多数投票曲线的上升值都在其中。 跨模型版本的可靠性更难确定:两个最新的模型只在未日期的名称下可用,因此同名后期运行可能会到达不同的模型.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The framework discriminates, and says where. Applied to one instrument, the validity framework does more than rank models. It locates their failures. The oldest models fail the most basic theoretical test, and for them the other tests are empty. The newest pass every theoretical test we can score and diverge only under convergent validity, in the level and income sensitivity of their values. A single accuracy score could not make that distinction, and without ground truth there would be no accuracy score to compute.
blocks.zh: 框架歧视,并说在哪里。 适用于一种文书,有效性框架的效绩超过等级模型. 它找出他们的失败。 最古老的模型未能通过最基本的理论测试,对于它们来说,其他测试都是空的. 最新通过的每一个理论测试,我们只能在其价值水平和收入敏感性的趋同有效性下进行得分和分歧。 单一的准确分数无法作出这种区分,没有事实根据,就没有准确分数可以计算。

blocks.en: Consistency is not accuracy. A model that passes these tests has shown that its answers are coherent, not that they are right. Theoretical validity is a necessary condition for trusting a model’s judgement, not a sufficient one. A model could also pass by applying a well-learned rule of thumb, such as a fixed share of income discounted for distance, and these tests cannot tell such a rule from genuine weighing of the scenario. Models trained on text that includes the SP literature may know what the tests expect. Withholding the scale’s name limits that risk; it does not remove it.
blocks.zh: 一致性并不准确。 一个通过这些测试的模型表明,它的答案是连贯的,而不是正确的。 理论有效性是相信模型判断的必要条件,而不是充分的判断。 一个模型也可以通过运用一个经验丰富的拇指规则而通过,例如对距离进行固定的收入折扣,这些测试不能从真实的衡量情景中看出这种规则。 包括SP文献在内的文本培训模型可能知道测试的期望。 持之以恒会限制这种风险,

blocks.en: What does not transfer is where the open questions are. Criterion validity has no direct counterpart, because a model never pays; its analogue, whether what a model says matches what it does when acting, is a question for agentic evaluation. Incentive compatibility and consequentiality presuppose a respondent with something at stake. Whether an LLM’s answers change when it is told its advice will be acted on, or when a question’s format invites agreement, is testable, and it connects SP practice directly to current concerns about evaluation awareness and sycophancy.
blocks.zh: 不转移的,是问题所在。 标准有效性没有直接对应,因为一个模型从不支付;它的模拟,一个模型说它的行为是否与它的行为相符,是一个代理评价的问题. 奖励的相容性和后果性是以有利害关系者为先决条件的。 LLM的答案是否在被告知其建议会被执行时,或者当一个问题的格式引起同意时,都是可以验证的,它直接将SP的做法与当前对评价意识和节奏的关注联系起来.

blocks.en: Limits. This is one instrument and one good. The tax ladder tops out at $3,000, so many comparisons pass by default. Ten draws per tax make individual calls noisy, and the first round was exploratory. The two newest models ran under undated names at provider-default settings. At $75,000, the local- and non-local-watershed cells come from the first round and the study-region cells from the second, a week later. Because Sonnet 5 and Terra were called under undated names, the two sides of those spatial-extent comparisons, and of the $35,000-to-$75,000 income comparisons for the watershed cells, may not come from the same model. The same-day $35,000 comparisons give the same spatial-extent verdicts: Sonnet 5 and Terra pass all three, and four of the five failures occur there. We did not swap the order of the Yes and No options (the prompt lists No first). A yes-bias tied to option order or wording would raise vote shares at every tax. For models whose curves fall within the tax range this would mostly shift the level, but for the models that vote yes at nearly every price it could be what makes the curve flat. We plan to run the swap.
blocks.zh: 限制。 这是一个工具 一个好。 税收阶梯高达3000美元,因此许多比较默认通过. 每税有10个抽取使个别电话发出噪音,第一轮是探索性的。 两个最新的模型在提供者-默认设置中以未日期的名称运行. 以75,000元计,当地与非当地合水细胞来自第一轮,学习区细胞来自两周后. 由于Sonnet 5 和 Terra 是以未注明日期的名称称呼的,这些空间范围比较的两面以及分水岭细胞35 000美元与75 000美元收入比较的两面可能并非来自同一模式。 同一天的35 000美元比较给出了相同的空间范围判断: Sonnet 5和Terra通过全部三个,五个失败中的四个发生在那里. 我们没有交换 " 是 " 和 " 不 " 选项的顺序(即时列表没有第一个)。 与选择令或措辞挂钩的赞成立场将提高每税的投票份额。 对于曲线在税率范围内的模型来说,这大多会改变水平,但对于几乎以每个价格投赞成票的模型来说,可能是使曲线平平的原因。 我们计划进行交换

blocks.en: Conclusion. The SP literature spent decades learning how to judge answers that cannot be checked against the truth. Those lessons carry over to language models, whose answers to questions of value, judgement, and advice cannot be checked against the truth either. The next steps are to apply the framework outside economics and to test the concepts that do not yet transfer.
blocks.zh: 结论。 SP文献花了几十年时间学习如何判断无法与真相相抗衡的答案. 这些经验教训延续到语言模式,语言模式对价值问题、判断和建议的答案也无法与真相相提并论。 接下来的步骤是将框架应用到经济学之外,并测试尚未转移的概念.
